doc.title: Curtis Fuller — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Growing up in a Jesuit-run Detroit orphanage and the schools
summary: Fuller grew up in a children's society run by the Jesuits near the university, one of three non-white kids, and went to public schools.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: School days: grades, teachers and leaving school

blocks.x: So, you grew up in an orphanage?

Yes, and I was one of three ethnic kids at this particular orphanage. It was called Children’s A Society in Detroit, Michigan. It was about four blocks away from away from the University on Second Avenue. It was ran by the Jesuit Society. That’s where I grew up.
So, you were educated in a Jesuit system?
Yes, system, but not actually. The schools were…about to go to the public schools, whatever denomination you were.
What public schools did you go to in Detroit?
